t.p: The first four columns ignore date/company filters entirely — they check whether the data exists for this user at all. The last two run the real code with no filter, and then again with whatever date/company you currently have selected up top ( → · company ) — this second run is what should match what actually shows on their own page.

td.t-esc: r.live_error_current_filters ? 'ERROR — hover' : (r.live_rows_current_filters === null ? '(no filters set)' : r.live_rows_current_filters)

t.p: "Created by them" > 0 but "Their edit messages" = 0 for a type they've definitely edited → the edit isn't being attributed to their account at write time. "Their edit messages" > 0 but "...with tracked changes" = 0 (highlighted) → the message exists but no tracked field's value actually changed, or that field isn't marked as tracked on this model. "Real method, no filter" > 0 but "Real method, current filters" is 0 or an error (highlighted) → the data is there and the code works, but today's date or company filter is excluding it — that's the one to send me.

div.p: Only administrators can change these settings. Showing current values.
Products at or below this quantity are flagged "Low Stock" across the dashboard.
Invoices aren't counted "overdue" until this many days past their due date.

How far back to look when ranking products into Fast/Medium/Slow-Moving. Products are ranked against each other by units sold in this window and split into thirds, so there's no separate amount to set — a shorter window reacts faster to recent sales, a longer one smooths out one-off spikes. A product with zero sales in the window is always Slow-Moving.
